high_level_description: The image features a colorful, patterned jacket displayed on a mannequin against a backdrop of a grid-patterned wall. The jacket is predominantly black with vibrant, abstract patterns in shades of green, pink, yellow, and white. The patterns appear to be geometric and organic, creating a dynamic and lively design. The mannequin is positioned centrally, with the jacket hanging neatly over it. The collar of the jacket is white, providing a stark contrast to the darker colors of the jacket itself. A tag is visible at the back of the collar, indicating the brand "JUXAR.
